description: Create a to-do (item max 50 chars; longer text in details). Optionally tie it to a booking/client, set due_date ('YYYY-MM-DD' or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS') and urgent. contact_id (optional) ties it to the person at that client to follow up with. It lands on the dashboard of the user this key belongs to, or assign_to (a teammate's login or user_id); is_global shows it to everyone.

booking_id.description: A booking's id (from list_bookings or search).

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

name: create_todo
title: Create Todo
